title: Semantic versions
hints: parse: split at the dots, check there are exactly three parts and each is made of digits (part.isdigit()), and return a tuple of ints.
bump: major gives (major + 1, 0, 0), minor gives (major, minor + 1, 0), patch gives (major, minor, patch + 1).

next_version: work out a level for each commit (2 for breaking, 1 for feat, 0 for fix), take the highest, and bump accordingly. A breaking change has ! before the colon, or the text BREAKING CHANGE anywhere.
newest: max(versions, key=parse) compares the versions as tuples of numbers.
